name: answer-reaches-only-successor
invariant: A ruling answers an owed input and re-keys the review through its successor only: the round 2 review declaring the answer has another computation key than the review that asked (found/review_input_changed), and a successor answering an owed input its predecessor did not owe is refused (failed/lineage_undeclared) (13 "Successor rounds"; 11:155, 156).
